title: Stocks to buy for short term: Amol Athawale of Kotak Securities recommends 3 shares for next 1-2 weeks

title: From Gift Nifty to US Fed meeting outcome: 8 key things that changed for Indian stock market overnight

title: Indo-MIM IPO listing date today. GMP, analysts signal share debut at a strong premium on BSE, NSE
text: Indo-MIM IPO listing date is 30 July 2026, and the stock will be listed on both the stock exchanges, BSE and NSE. Ahead of the share debut, Indo-MIM IPO GMP today and analysts signal a strong listing of shares.

title: Oil prices fall amid ongoing US-Iran war tension; Brent crude at $87 per barrel
text: US-Iran war: Brent crude futures declined 79 cents, or 0.9%, to $87.30 per barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude fell 76 cents, or 0.9%, to $83.70 per barrel.
